segments.name: Biometric identification
segments.description: Provides biometric identification, authentication and enrollment software, SDKs and services to government and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: AwareABIS has primarily been sold as a fixed term license that is priced based on the size of the biometric system or on a subscription-based model.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for perpetual and fixed-term software licenses, subscriptions, SaaS offerings, maintenance and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: License and service contracts include revenue recognized from perpetual software licenses, professional services, and associated maintenance contracts.
